The '''Partold system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Partold]] social group.<ref name="BadFeeling" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Partold system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square T-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
